auditory_note: Tap ▶ Listen to play each clip.

banner.body_en: Whenever you have a few minutes, reply with your answers to Lesson 8 (numbers) and Lesson 9 (names and ages) so I can grade them. No rush, and today's lesson is a gentle one: we start the next category, colors, with just a few words.
banner.body_py: Nǐ yǒu kòng de shíhou, qǐng huífù dì-bā kè hé dì-jiǔ kè de dá'àn, wǒ lái pǔfēn. Bù jí. Jīntiān de kè hěn qīngsōng: wǒmen kāishǐ xué xīn de zhǔtí, yánsè, zhǐ yǒu jǐ gè cí.

intro.en: Hi Evan! You've done a lot with family and people, so today we start a brand new category: colors. Kids learn colors early, and you'll see why: they're easy to point at and fun to talk about. You'll learn the word for color, three color words (red, blue, white), and xǐhuan (to like), which lets you say "I like blue" or ask "What color do you like?" We'll also warm up numbers and names from the last two lessons.
intro.py: Nǐ hǎo, Evan! Nǐ zài jiātíng hé rén de zhǔtí shàng xué le hěn duō, jīntiān wǒmen kāishǐ yí gè quánxīn de zhǔtí: yánsè. Xiǎo háizi hěn zǎo jiù xué yánsè, yīnwèi yánsè hěn róngyì zhǐ, yě hěn hǎowán. Nǐ huì xué yánsè zhège cí, sān gè yánsè cí (hóng, lán, bái), hái yǒu xǐhuan, yǒu le tā nǐ jiù néng shuō “Wǒ xǐhuan lánsè”, yě néng wèn “Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?” Wǒmen yě fùxí qián liǎng kè de shùzì hé míngzi.

blocks.note_en: Rising 2nd tone on YÁN, then a falling 4th tone on SÈ. This word is the "category name" for all the colors.
blocks.note_py: Yán shì dì-èr shēng, sè shì dì-sì shēng. Zhège cí shì suǒyǒu yánsè de zǒngchēng.

blocks.note_en: 2nd tone then 4th, exactly like yánsè. The sè at the end means "color," and every color word below ends the same way.
blocks.note_py: Dì-èr shēng jiā dì-sì shēng, gēn yánsè yíyàng. Hòumiàn de sè jiù shì “yánsè”, xiàmiàn de yánsè cí dōu yǐ sè jiéwěi.

blocks.note_en: Same 2nd + 4th tone pattern again, so you only have to learn one rhythm for these three.
blocks.note_py: Hái shì dì-èr shēng jiā dì-sì shēng, suǒyǐ nǐ zhǐ yào xué yí gè jiézòu.

blocks.note_en: Another 2nd + 4th. Notice how all three colors sound like a little drumbeat: dum-DUM.
blocks.note_py: Yòu shì dì-èr shēng jiā dì-sì shēng. Zhè sān gè yánsè tīng qǐlái xiàng yí gè xiǎo gǔdiǎn.

blocks.note_en: 3rd tone on XǏ, then a light neutral huan. When wǒ or nǐ comes right before it, the two 3rd tones meet, so say wó xǐhuan and ní xǐhuan.
blocks.note_py: Xǐ shì dì-sān shēng, huan shì qīngshēng. Wǒ huò nǐ zài tā qiánmiàn shí, liǎng gè dì-sān shēng xiāngyù, yào dú chéng wó xǐhuan, ní xǐhuan.

blocks.note_en: Word for word: "You like what color?" You already know shénme from Lesson 9, and it still stays right where the answer goes.
blocks.note_py: Zhè jù huà jiù shì: nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè? Shénme nǐ zài dì-jiǔ kè xué guò le, tā réngrán fàng zài dá'àn de wèizhi.

blocks.title: 🔑 Pattern: I like + thing
blocks.body_en: To say what you like, put xǐhuan right after the person and then say the thing. Chinese never adds a little extra word here, so it is as simple as "I like blue." And because shénme stays in place, the question and answer look almost the same.
blocks.body_py: Yào shuō nǐ xǐhuan shénme, bǎ xǐhuan fàng zài rén de hòumiàn, ránhòu shuō dōngxi. Zhōngwén zhèlǐ bú yòng jiā bié de cí, suǒyǐ jiù xiàng “I like blue” yíyàng jiǎndān. Yīnwèi shénme bù dòng, wèntí hé dá'àn chàbuduō yíyàng.

pairs.en: What color do you like? / I like blue.
pairs.py: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè? / Wǒ xǐhuan lánsè.

blocks.title: ✨ Bonus: really like
blocks.body_en: Put hěn (very) before xǐhuan to say you really like something. You already know hěn, jiā, and de, so this one is mostly review.
blocks.body_py: Zài xǐhuan qiánmiàn jiā hěn, jiù shì hěn xǐhuan. Hěn, jiā hé de nǐ dōu xué guò le, suǒyǐ zhè jù jīhū shì fùxí.

pairs.py: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan wǒ de jiā.

blocks.en: These words from Lessons 8 and 9 haven't been practiced yet, so let's give them a first warm-up. Listen, then say each one out loud.
blocks.py: Zhèxiē cí shì dì-bā kè hé dì-jiǔ kè xué de, hái méiyǒu liànxí guò, suǒyǐ xiān rè rè shēn. Xiān tīng, ránhòu dàshēng shuō.
Wǒ hěn xǐhuan wǒ de jiā.

blocks.en: I like blue, he likes red.
blocks.py: Wǒ xǐhuan lánsè, tā xǐhuan hóngsè.

practice.how_to: Type your answers in the boxes below. Use tone marks on every pinyin answer (missing tones earn half credit). For 🎤 S1–S3, record a short clip on this page (you can replay and re-record; each clip stops at about 20 seconds). Then tap Submit to see your written score right away.

sections.title: B · Fill in the blank
sections.options_line: Choose from: xǐhuan · shénme · sān · jiào

items.prompt_en: What color do you like? Answer in a full pinyin sentence.
Pick a color your kid likes (or guess!) and write it in pinyin.

intro_callout.title: Send a voice memo in Mandarin Tutor chat
intro_callout.body_en: Email can't record audio. Listen to each model first, then read S1–S3 aloud in one memo. Watch the tone changes: wǒ xǐhuan sounds like wó xǐhuan in S1, and nǐ jiào sounds like ní jiào in S2.
intro_callout.body_py: Diànzǐ yóujiàn bù néng lùyīn. Xiān tīng, ránhòu bǎ S1 dào S3 dàshēng dú chūlái. S1 lǐ wǒ xǐhuan shuō chéng wó xǐhuan, S2 lǐ nǐ jiào shuō chéng ní jiào.

items.prompt_en: He is four. He likes blue.
items.prompt_py: Tā sì suì. Tā xǐhuan lánsè.

closing.en: Nice work, Evan! Today, try pointing at three things around you and saying their color, even just "hóngsè!" Tap Submit when your written answers and voice memos are ready. Jiāyóu!
closing.py: Zuò de hěn hǎo, Evan! Jīntiān shìshi zhǐzhe shēnbiān sān yàng dōngxi shuō tāmen de yánsè, jiùshì shuō “hóngsè!” yě kěyǐ. Nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le jiù huífù, yǔyīn qǐng fā dào Mandarin Tutor liáotiān lǐ. Jiāyóu!
